subject.title: feat(config): support externally managed GitOps config

question: Should the maintained Kubernetes manifests switch existing deployments to externally managed ConfigMap ownership by default in this PR?
rationale: This protected PR introduces a new host ownership contract and changes the maintained deployment’s source of truth, mutation behavior, and upgrade workflow; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Adopt with migration guardrails
options.body: Use managed ConfigMap ownership by default after adding explicit upgrade steps and proof that existing PVC config is preserved or exported before the switch.

options.title: Make managed mode opt-in
options.body: Keep mutable PVC config as the maintained default and provide a separate GitOps overlay or documented opt-in manifest.

options.title: Split the deployment default
options.body: Land the generic ownership and reload primitives after repair while deferring the maintained Kubernetes default change to a separately approved PR.

recommendation.title: Adopt with migration guardrails
recommendation.body: Use managed ConfigMap ownership by default after adding explicit upgrade steps and proof that existing PVC config is preserved or exported before the switch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the reload feature, owns major recent work in the path, and opened the canonical product-direction issue.
